title: Annual Report
summary: ECB Annual Report 2024 landing page presenting high-level summary statistics: headline inflation fell to 2.4% in December 2024 (from 2.9% in December 2023), moving closer to the 2% target; ECB cut interest rates four times in 2024 for a cumulative 100 basis point reduction, bringing the deposit facility rate to 3.00%.
key_points: Headline inflation declined to 2.4% in December 2024 from 2.9% in December 2023, moving closer to the 2% target
ECB cut interest rates four times in 2024, reducing the deposit facility rate to 3.00%
Cumulative rate decrease over 2024 was 100 basis points
ECB Visitor Centre hosted 21,325 visitors in 2024
Luis de Guindos (ECB Vice President) presented the Annual Report to the European Parliament's Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs
why_it_matters: The Annual Report summarizes ECB monetary policy for 2024, providing a consolidated reference for the ECB's policy trajectory. The reported data points (inflation at 2.4%, deposit rate at 3.00%, 100 bps of cuts) confirm the direction and magnitude of ECB easing through 2024.
macro_context: The report confirms that ECB policy normalization progressed through 2024 with 100 bps of rate cuts, reflecting successful disinflation from 2.9% to 2.4% headline CPI. The deposit facility rate of 3.00% represents the endpoint of the 2024 easing cycle.
important_numbers: 3.00% — deposit facility rate after four 2024 cuts
100 basis points — cumulative rate reduction in 2024
